name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Automatic copy choice and weak-server protection. A server with no hardware encoder and fewer than 4 CPU threads now converts nothing on its own (the conversion setting's default is Automatic; choose "Everything, even if this server looks too weak" to override). When a title has several copies, the copy a device can play as stored now ranks above one that would need converting, sound in the user's Jellyfin language is preferred (English when unset), and the choice is per device: active with "pick the best copy automatically" on, and always on a server that may not convert. Friends' link speeds are now averaged from hourly samples over the first day, then daily. Not yet verified on physical TV or phone players.
